currentUserGoal: Continue from the latest handoff and address the next mobile performance target: Quest Log scrolling.
changesMade: Added Quest Log phases to the repeatable perf harness: questOpen and questScroll.
Split Quest Log layout so full overlay layout handles headers, masks, filters, and cached filtered quest rows, while scroll only repositions visible row views.
Skipped quest row text/status refresh during scroll for rows that were already visible, refreshing only newly visible rows or full-layout refreshes.
Coalesced multiple Quest Log scroll updates in the same frame so drag/wheel bursts produce one visible row reposition.
Documented the new questOpen and questScroll harness phases in docs/PERFORMANCE_HARNESS.md.
verification: npm run build passed after the code changes.

Baseline focused mobile harness at http://127.0.0.1:5173/?perfHarness&tiles=1200&v=quest-instrumented-baseline reproduced the Quest Log scroll issue: questScroll maxFrameDeltaMs 35, frameSpikes 7, visibleTiles 18, layoutPasses 0, redraws 0, redrawQueued 0, displayObjects 181, activeTweens 19.
After row-only scroll layout but before coalescing, questScroll improved to maxFrameDeltaMs 31 and frameSpikes 0.

Final mobile harness at http://127.0.0.1:5173/?perfHarness&tiles=1200&v=quest-scroll-coalesced completed all phases with questScroll maxFrameDeltaMs 9, frameSpikes 0, visibleTiles 18, layoutPasses 0, redraws 0, redrawQueued 0, displayObjects 195, activeTweens 19.
Final complete phase remained clean: visibleTiles 15, layoutPasses 0, redraws 0, redrawQueued 0, maxFrameDeltaMs 9, frameSpikes 0, displayObjects 212, activeTweens 22.

Manual mobile visual check at http://127.0.0.1:5173/?stress&perf&tiles=1200&v=quest-visual-check-2 opened the Quest Log from the mobile dock and dragged the list; perf overlay showed ui:questScroll 3.5/2.4x4, maxFrameDeltaMs 11, frameSpikes 0.
Browser console warning/error log was empty for harness and visual checks.
